generation.scope: The entire finite vertex-index-two branch, including exceptional values, consists exactly of ordinary period-one graded Clifford windows of basepoint-free webs of quadrics meeting the symmetric rank-at-most-two locus in a finite scheme. Indexed isomorphism is precisely projective equivalence of the webs. The center is the quartic symmetroid double solid with doubled polarization; the web locus is irreducible of dimension nine modulo isomorphism.

open_mathematics: Analyze the remaining finite index-four central and noncentral windows; in particular determine which finite regular specializations of the main component retain central parameters.
